doc.claim: On two isotropic unit-variance 10-d Gaussian classes whose means are 3 units apart along one axis (Bayes accuracy Φ(1.5) ≈ 93.3%), with balanced classes, n_train = 2000 and n_test = 10000 per seed, logistic regression run through the supplied harness attains mean held-out accuracy below 90% over 10 seeds, while an independent reference pipeline (raw features → sklearn LogisticRegression, default L2, C = 1.0) on the identical splits attains at least 90% on every seed.

null_arm.expect: shuffled-label model accuracy about one half

positive_control.description: the same pipeline on classes separated by a much larger margin, where any working linear classifier is near-perfect
positive_control.expect: near-perfect accuracy if the instrument works

predictions.statement: Mean held-out accuracy across seeds stays below 0.90 (logistic regression cannot reach it on this task).
